description.en: Busa Finance: a review workspace for a three-statement financial model — the current model snapshot (company/currency/periods/workbook), its model-quality check queue (balance-sheet ties, cash roll-forward, formula reviews), and sanitized settings
description.zh-CN: Busa Finance：三表联动财务模型的审核工作台——当前模型快照（公司/币种/期间/工作簿）、模型质量检查队列（资产负债表勾稽、现金滚存、公式复核），以及脱敏后的设置。

agentPrompts: Summarize the latest Model and flag what needs my attention.
Open Busa Finance and show me the items that need review.
